name: Post
summary: Makes a position a party in its own right, so that a responsibility attached to the job survives whoever is holding it.

roles.name: Post
roles.summary: A position the organization deals with as it deals with a person or an organization — the third kind of party, and the whole of the pattern. Because it is a party, every responsibility a party can hold attaches to it with no new machinery, and a handover changes who occupies it without touching one of them. A responsibility recorded against the person instead disappears the day they change job, and nothing reports that it has.
